```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
ROOT <- "/users/4/coffm049/papers/functionalBrainHerit"
# For local render (Windows) the same relative paths work; ROOT not needed for images
WIDE <- file.path(ROOT, "results/summary/mash_twin_wide.csv")
wide <- tryCatch(read_csv(WIDE, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())

fivenum_tbl <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x)==0) return(tibble(min=NA, q1=NA, median=NA, mean=NA, q3=NA, max=NA, n=0, sd=NA))
  tibble(
    min = min(x), q1 = quantile(x, 0.25), median = median(x),
    mean = mean(x), q3 = quantile(x, 0.75), max = max(x),
    n = length(x), sd = sd(x)
  )
}
# Helper to filter n=0 rows for publication (per user: filter all tables to remove n=0)
filter_n0 <- function(df) {
  if ("n" %in% names(df)) df <- df %>% filter(n != 0)
  if ("n_valid" %in% names(df)) df <- df %>% filter(n_valid != 0)
  if ("n_networks" %in% names(df)) df <- df %>% filter(n_networks != 0)
  if ("n_pheno" %in% names(df)) df <- df %>% filter(n_pheno != 0)
  df
}
```

# Summary {.scrollable style="text-align:center;"}

::: {style="overflow-y:auto; max-height:820px; text-align:left; font-size:1.15em; line-height:1.6;"}

- **Brain wiring is heritable:** Both twin and DNA-based (SNP) estimates show heritability for functional connections (`Gordon`/`ProbaConns`) and for network surface area, but DNA captures only ~30% of twin heritability on average.
- **Networks differ:** Some systems (e.g., `DMN`, `VIS`, `DAN`) are more heritable than others, and the pattern is similar for `Gordon` and `ProbaConns`.
- **Total brain size matters for surface area:** Controlling for total surface area (`w_total`) lowers heritability and changes which networks look most heritable.
- **Surface vs. wiring are weakly linked:** How heritable a network's surface area is only weakly predicts how heritable its connections are.
- **Methods agree:** Twin and SNP (`AdjHE-RE`) estimates are correlated (`Pearson R` ~0.6–0.8 per phenotype set), supporting the SNP findings.

:::

## Gordon — Five-Number Summaries & Correlations

```{r gordon-stats}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 5
if (nrow(wide)>0) {
  gordon_wide <- wide %>% filter(Set=="gordon")
  # Twin vs AdjHE-RE comparison for fivenum
  gordon_long <- gordon_wide %>%
    select(Pheno, Twin_h2, h2_gordon_AdjHE_RE) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(Twin_h2, h2_gordon_AdjHE_RE), names_to="Method", values_to="h2") %>%
    mutate(Method = recode(Method, Twin_h2="Twin", h2_gordon_AdjHE_RE="AdjHE-RE"))
  # fivenum per Method — filter n=0 (per user)
  fivenum_gordon <- gordon_long %>%
    group_by(Method) %>% summarise(fivenum_tbl(h2), .groups="drop") %>% filter(n != 0) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x,3)))
  kable(filter_n0(fivenum_gordon), caption="Gordon — h2 five-number summary (Twin vs AdjHE-RE, 30 PCs)")
} else { cat("mash_twin_wide.csv not found — run 01_compare_mash_twin.R"); cat("\n") }
```

```{r gordon-corr}
if (file.exists(file.path(ROOT,"results/summary/correlations_by_set.csv"))) {
  corr <- read_csv(file.path(ROOT,"results/summary/correlations_by_set.csv"), show_col_types=FALSE) %>% filter(Set=="gordon")
  if ("n" %in% names(corr)) corr <- corr %>% filter(n != 0)
  # Only Pearson R per user (remove Spearman/R2)
  corr <- corr %>% select(any_of(c("Set","MashMethod","n","Pearson_r"))) %>% mutate(Pearson_r = round(Pearson_r, 3))
  kable(filter_n0(corr), caption="Gordon — Twin vs MASH Pearson R")
} else if (nrow(wide)>0) {
  tmp <- gordon_wide %>% select(Twin_h2, h2_gordon_AdjHE_RE) %>% drop_na()
  if (nrow(tmp)>2) {
    kable(tibble(Set="gordon", MashMethod="h2_gordon_AdjHE_RE", n=nrow(tmp), Pearson_r=round(cor(tmp$Twin_h2, tmp$h2_gordon_AdjHE_RE),3)) %>% filter(n != 0), caption="Gordon — Twin vs AdjHE-RE Pearson R")
  }
}
```

```{r sa-wtotal-stats}
# Try w_total columns if 01_compare_mash_twin.R has been updated to include them;
# otherwise this gracefully falls back to wo_total with a note.
wcols <- grep("w_total", names(wide), value=TRUE)
if (length(wcols)>0) {
  sa_w <- wide %>% filter(Set=="SA") %>% select(Pheno, all_of(wcols), Twin_h2) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(wcols), names_to="Method", values_to="h2") %>%
    mutate(Method = gsub("h2_SA_|_w_total", "", Method))
  fivenum_saw <- sa_w %>% group_by(Method) %>% summarise(fivenum_tbl(h2), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x,3)))
  kable(filter_n0(fivenum_saw), caption="SA w_total — h2 five-number summary (if w_total columns present)")
} else {
  cat("No w_total columns in mash_twin_wide.csv yet — run w_total SLURMs and rebuild 01_compare_mash_twin.R with w_total pattern.\n")

}
```

## SA-FC System Correlation — FC parcel-mean / 90th percentile / within-system h2 vs SA h2

```{r sa-fc-corr}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
corr_path <- file.path(ROOT, "results/summary/sa_fc_h2_correlation.csv")
# Fallback for Windows local render
if (!file.exists(corr_path)) corr_path <- file.path("results", "summary", "sa_fc_h2_correlation.csv")
if (file.exists(corr_path)) {
  corr_sa_fc <- tryCatch(read_csv(corr_path, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  if (nrow(corr_sa_fc) == 0 || !"pearson_r" %in% names(corr_sa_fc)) {
    cat("sa_fc_h2_correlation.csv is empty (0 rows or missing pearson_r). Re-run `python summary/04b_h2_SA_correlation.py` and check /tmp/04b.log for df_net n=.\n")
  } else {
    # Filter n=0 and keep only Pearson R per user (remove Spearman/R2)
    if ("n_networks" %in% names(corr_sa_fc)) corr_sa_fc <- corr_sa_fc %>% filter(n_networks != 0)
    corr_sa_fc <- corr_sa_fc %>% select(any_of(c("atlas","method","metric","sa_type","n_networks","pearson_r"))) %>% mutate(pearson_r = round(pearson_r, 3))
    kable(filter_n0(corr_sa_fc), caption="SA-FC h2 by system: Pearson R of parcel-mean / 90th percentile / within-system FC h2 vs SA h2 (14 nets, w_total + wo_total, per atlas × Twin vs AdjHE-RE)")
  }
} else {
  cat("Run `python summary/04b_h2_SA_correlation.py` to generate sa_fc_h2_correlation.csv\n")
}
```

```{r sa-fc-scatter}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
# SA h2 (x) vs FC within-system / outside-system h2 (y) per network — within vs across w.r.t. SA
detail_path <- file.path(ROOT, "results/summary/sa_fc_per_network.csv")
if (!file.exists(detail_path)) detail_path <- file.path("results", "summary", "sa_fc_per_network.csv")
if (file.exists(detail_path)) {
  det <- tryCatch(read_csv(detail_path, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  if (nrow(det) > 0 && all(c("sa_h2","fc_within","fc_outside") %in% names(det))) {
    det_long <- det %>% select(any_of(c("atlas","method","sa_type","network","sa_h2","fc_within","fc_outside"))) %>%
      pivot_longer(c(fc_within, fc_outside), names_to = "metric", values_to = "fc_h2") %>%
      mutate(metric = recode(metric, fc_within = "within-system", fc_outside = "outside-system")) %>%
      filter(is.finite(sa_h2), is.finite(fc_h2))
    if (nrow(det_long) > 0) {
      p <- ggplot(det_long, aes(x = sa_h2, y = fc_h2, color = metric)) +
        geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
        facet_grid(method ~ atlas) +
        labs(x = "SA h2 per network", y = "FC h2 per network", color = "FC edges") +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
      print(p)
    }
  } else {
    cat("sa_fc_per_network.csv empty — re-run `python summary/04b_h2_SA_correlation.py`.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Run `python summary/04b_h2_SA_correlation.py` to generate sa_fc_per_network.csv for within/outside scatter.\n")
}
```

```{r fc-dist-within-across}
# h2 vs distance, split within (same_network TRUE) vs across (FALSE) — per atlas × method
dist_path <- file.path(ROOT, "results/summary/fc_distance_per_edge.csv")
if (!file.exists(dist_path)) dist_path <- file.path("results", "summary", "fc_distance_per_edge.csv")
if (file.exists(dist_path)) {
  dd <- tryCatch(read_csv(dist_path, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  if (nrow(dd) > 0 && all(c("h2","euclidean_dist","same_network") %in% names(dd))) {
    dd <- dd %>% mutate(group = if_else(same_network, "within", "across"))
    dist_sum <- dd %>% group_by(atlas, method, group) %>%
      summarise(
        n = sum(is.finite(h2)),
        mean_h2 = mean(h2, na.rm = TRUE),
        p10_h2 = quantile(h2, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
        p50_h2 = quantile(h2, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
        p90_h2 = quantile(h2, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_euclid = mean(euclidean_dist, na.rm = TRUE),
        pearson_h2_euclid = suppressWarnings(cor(h2, euclidean_dist, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")),
        pearson_h2_geodesic = suppressWarnings(cor(h2, geodesic_dist, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      filter(n != 0) %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3)))
    kable(filter_n0(dist_sum), caption="FC h2 vs distance — within (same network) vs across (different networks): n, mean/p10/p50/p90 h2, mean Euclidean, Pearson R(h2, Euclidean) and R(h2, geodesic)")
  } else {
    cat("fc_distance_per_edge.csv empty — re-run `python summary/04f_FC_distance.py` (needs wb_command module for geodesic).\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Run `python summary/04f_FC_distance.py` to generate fc_distance_per_edge.csv\n")
}
```

```{r percent-snp}
if (!file.exists(pct_detail_path)) pct_detail_path <- file.path("results", "summary", "percent_SNP_explained_per_pheno.csv")
if (file.exists(pct_path)) {
  pct <- read_csv(pct_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 2)))
  # Filter n=0
  pct <- filter_n0(pct)
  # Keep Set order gordon, probaConns, SA; select only needed cols for display (keep Pearson focus but percent table is separate)
  pct <- pct %>% arrange(match(Set, c("gordon","probaConns","SA")))
  # Only show mean/median + SE for publication (keep full for now but ensure n_valid !=0)
  kable(pct, caption="Percent SNP heritability of Twin estimates — 100 × AdjHE-RE / Twin per phenotype (per Set: mean ± SE, median, SD, q1/q3, min/max, n_valid; SA 14 nets excl. 4/6/17, FCs filtered Twin_h2>0.001, MASH 0–1.2)")
  cat("\n\n*Interpretation: `mean_pct` = mean of per-phenotype `pct`; `se_pct = sd / sqrt(n_valid)`; `median_pct` robust to outliers (Twin near 0 inflates mean). `ratio_of_means_pct = 100 × mean(MASH)/mean(Twin)` is also shown.*\n")
} else {
  cat("Run `Rscript summary/04d_percent_SNP.R` to generate percent_SNP_explained.csv\n")
}
```

## SA wo_total — Five-Number Summaries & Correlations

```{r sa-stats-appendix}
if (nrow(wide)>0) {
  sa_long <- wide %>% filter(Set=="SA") %>%
    select(Pheno, Twin_h2, h2_SA_AdjHE_RE) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(Twin_h2, h2_SA_AdjHE_RE), names_to="Method", values_to="h2") %>%
    mutate(Method = recode(Method, Twin_h2="Twin", h2_SA_AdjHE_RE="AdjHE-RE"))
  fivenum_sa <- sa_long %>% group_by(Method) %>% summarise(fivenum_tbl(h2), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x,3)))
  kable(filter_n0(fivenum_sa), caption="SA (wo_total, 14 networks excl. 4/6/17 null) — h2 five-number summary")
}
```

## SA w_total vs wo_total — Correlation & Comparison {.scrollable style="text-align:center;"}

*Comparison of SA heritability estimates with vs without total surface area control (per network, 14 nets excl. 4/6/17).*

```{r sa-w-vs-wo-corr-appendix}
# Pearson R between w_total and wo_total per Method (Twin, AdjHE-RE) — only Pearson per user
r2_path <- file.path(ROOT, "results/summary/r2_sa_w_vs_wo_total.csv")
if (file.exists(r2_path)) {
  r2 <- read_csv(r2_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if ("n" %in% names(r2)) r2 <- r2 %>% filter(n != 0)
  r2 <- r2 %>% select(any_of(c("Set","Method","n","Pearson_r"))) %>% mutate(Pearson_r = round(Pearson_r, 3))
  kable(filter_n0(r2), caption="SA w_total vs wo_total — Pearson R (per Method)")
} else {
  cat("Run `Rscript summary/04_compare_r2.R` to generate r2_sa_w_vs_wo_total.csv\n")
}
```
